method: Oculix focused the live fullscreen game and drove a checked title/character/save/QuickSave/Gus/inventory/journal path. The exact custom locale was selected before launch through Stardew's startup preferences and the original value was restored afterward. macOS captured every stable screen at native resolution; the locale label was added afterward without resizing.

findings.issue: Gus’s SpriteFont1 dialogue loses normal inter-word spacing and is laid out from the left edge; the resulting RTL reading order is not reliably readable.

screenshots.coverage: Localized title menu buttons and labels are visible and unclipped.
Character-creation labels and the lower-right Back button are visible and unclipped.
Gus's portrait, localized name, and multi-line dialogue are visible and unclipped.
The axe name, category, wrapped description, and inventory metadata are visible.
The expanded Introductions journal entry, body, and progress line fit the panel.
